title: Chris R NDE 736
content:
I passed out in car, awoke in an ambulance long enough to give name and address. I went out again. I felt that I was floating on an inner tube on a sun lit lake, completely surrounded by the sparkling reflections - diamond-like. I had a true feeling of peace, contentment, happiness. Then I faintly heard my name being called and a slight sensation of pressure on my chest. Reluctantly I responded and awoke in a hospital emergency room and immediately went out again. This time I found myself in the apartment I was living in at the time, which was at least sixty miles from the hospital. I was observing my roommates in the living room from my vantage point on the end of the couch, laughing to myself, knowing I could see them but they couldn't see me. Again I heard my name and pressure on my chest, and again reluctantly returned to my body.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: From a vantage point on the end of the couch in the apartment he was living in (about sixty miles from the hospital), observing roommates who could not see him.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: He heard his name being called and felt slight pressure on his chest, then 'responded' and awoke back in the emergency room/body; this happened twice.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Passed out in a car; later awoke briefly in an ambulance and in a hospital emergency room.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Two episodes: (1) peaceful scene floating on a sunlit lake; (2) OBE observing roommates in his apartment ~60 miles away; both ended by hearing his name and chest pressure followed by reluctant return.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: No tunnel/light/life review described; experience alternated between environments/OBE and returning after hearing his name and chest pressure, occurring twice.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: Return to body occurred twice after hearing his name and feeling pressure on his chest.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Felt like floating on an inner tube on a sunlit lake surrounded by sparkling diamond-like reflections; later perceived being in his apartment 60 miles away observing roommates who couldn't see him.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I felt that I was floating on an inner tube on a sun lit lake, completely surrounded by the sparkling reflections - diamond-like. I had a true feeling of peace, contentment, happiness.”
